rawContent: Starting with what’s #ontheradar, this week, we’ve seen many viral videos of powerful authority figures kneeling in support of the #BLM, which was a gesture originally popularized by @Kaepernick7. Tune into @am640 for our thoughts.

Next up, #TerryCrews is at it again, the actor tweeted “We must ensure #blacklivesmatter doesn’t morph into #blacklivesbetter”. Crews responded after the tweet got backlash from Twitter users. Listen on @am640 to hear if we think Crews is showing us he is not down for the cause.
